en: A black-and-white image shows a large, empty town square with cobblestone ground. In the center is a decorative fountain surrounded by a wrought-iron fence. Around the square are old buildings with steep gable roofs and multiple small dormer windows, typical of German architecture. Visible signs in German adorn the buildings, with shop names such as 'Goldener Anker', 'Hermann Streubel', and 'Marlin Silte'. There are a few people and a horse-drawn cart in the scene, evoking an early 20th-century European town.
